title: Select a listing broker
summary: Interview brokers, compare pricing opinions and marketing plans, and sign the listing agreement.
outlineSteps: Write down what the sale needs from a broker
List brokers active in the property type and submarket
Send each broker the same property package and request
Interview each broker on buyers, marketing plan and team
Compare pricing opinions against the sponsor's own valuation
Compare fee, term, exclusions and buyer-broker terms
Negotiate the listing agreement with counsel
Tell the brokers not chosen and record the choice
